description: Instagram caption from @abowlofstew (Balsamic and Red Onion Tatin) across 3 overlapping phone screenshots. Tricky parts: 'Big pinch of Salt and Black Pepper' and 'To Garnish' appear in screenshots 1 and 2, and the balsamic step appears in 2 and 3, so a careless read repeats them; phone status bar, Follow button, hashtags, and '1 day ago' are junk; the method uses veg oil that the ingredient list leaves out; '180oC' means 180°C.
